2126466997525631372.en_summary: Greetings aspiring futures market traders. Is your goal to make a lot of money trading quickly or to develop a process that can be profitable over many years? My goal when I entered the futures industry in 1975 was to make trading my own account my career. I lost money in 1975, 1976, 1977 and 1978. Tried many approaches until I stumbled upon the 1933 book by Richard W. Schabacker. One honor was writing the forward to the hard cover version of that book.
2126466997525631372.zh_summary: 問候有志期貨市場交易者。你的目標是快速賺很多錢，還是發展一個可多年獲利的過程？我在1975年進入期貨業時的目標是讓交易自己的帳戶成為職業。我在1975、1976、1977和1978年虧錢。嘗試許多方法直到偶然發現Richard W. Schabacker的1933年書籍。一項榮譽是為該書精裝版寫序。
